name: Fix log
author: Brett
description: Fix log + FYI phone notifications from Claude sessions (fix-log@1). Any session (voice, chat, headless) writes one short line per step of a fix: found (something needs fixing), trying (what it is trying), failed, fixed. Each line goes into the Fix log and out as an informational notification: the console bell and AmberX on Brett's phone. Never asks for anything: no approval, no veto. Lines of one fix share an issue id, so the bell keeps only the newest. Fix log page with filters (outcome, session, build, text, open issues). Per-outcome notify switches and a per-session flood limit. CLI fixlog.mjs, REST, MCP fix_log_* and axf fix-log … through plugin-commands@1.

items.title: Fix log: log one step of a fix and tell Brett on his phone (FYI only, never an approval). outcome found | trying | failed | fixed; text = one short line saying what; issue = the id the first line returned

issue.description: the issue id from the first line of this fix; left out = the session's open fix
